segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English, the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: I'm Georgie.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: And I'm Beth. You can read along with this podcast and find a worksheet to help you learn on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Hi Beth, how are you?

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I'm good, thank you. How are you?

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yes, I'm very well, thank you.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Today, we're talking about relationships and particularly romantic relationships.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: So, Beth, personal question. Are you in a relationship at the moment?

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I am. Yes, I'm married, so I'm definitely in a relationship. What about you?

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: I am not in a relationship. I am single.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Oh, married. So how did you meet your partner?

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Well, I met my husband at work in a previous job.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: We both worked there and we were friends and then, yeah, it kind of went from there.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: And then he was my boyfriend and now he's my husband.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Oh, nice. It's quite common to meet your partner at work, isn't it?

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah I think so Quite a few of my friends have met their partners at work as well So you single Georgie Do you like to go on dates

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Good question Sometimes I like going on dates Sometimes I don In general I just really like

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: meeting people. So for me, it's quite a nice way to meet people when you live in a city.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: but sometimes if you don't get on with the person it can be really awkward and uncomfortable.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah and I can imagine that you end up just asking the same questions to people.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yes you're right sometimes it can feel a bit like an interview you're just asking so what do you do

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: and do you have any siblings and things like that it can be quite boring but if you think of some

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: more interesting questions it can be more exciting.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah so what do you like to do on dates? Do you

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: go out for for a meal or something like that?

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Usually I go for a drink with the person but this

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: year is actually my new year's resolution to do more activity dates so more fun things like

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: playing pool or playing mini golf or something like that going for a walk going for a coffee just something different I think it will be more interesting for me

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah when I dated I went to a museum on a first date to the Science Museum in London And that was

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: really fun because it also gives you something to talk about because you've got funny things to look

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: at and stuff.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: That's very true. And also, I feel like you're not always face to face with the

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: person. You know, it doesn't feel as intense. Maybe you can have you can have more silences.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Yeah, that's true. Otherwise, it can be a bit awkward.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: So, Georgie, have any of your dates gone really well?

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Yes, actually. Last year, I had a date that went well and we started seeing each other

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: and we went on multiple dates.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Ah, okay. So if you are seeing someone, then it's less serious than being in a relationship.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: They're not quite your boyfriend or girlfriend, but you've seen this person quite a few times

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: and you're in the early stages maybe of a relationship.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Exactly. So how long have you been married?

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I've been married almost two years. So we got engaged probably about three years ago.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: and how did he propose

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Well actually he pretended that he had got me some earrings And when I opened the box they weren earrings at all It was a ring

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Oh were you surprised

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: I was very surprised Yeah

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: And I never got my earrings.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: Oh, no. Maybe I'll get you some earrings.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: Oh, thanks.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: We

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: had a romantic activity you do with someone.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: We had boyfriend and girlfriend, your romantic partner.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: If you are seeing someone, then you are in the early stages of a romantic relationship with someone.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: If you propose, you ask someone to marry you.

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: And if you're single, then you're not married or in a romantic relationship.

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: and that's it for this episode of real easy english to test what you've learned try the

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: worksheet on our website you can find a link in the notes for this episode

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: and next week

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: we'll talk about money

segments.speaker: Georgie
segments.text: see you then

segments.speaker: Beth
segments.text: bye

segments.text: Thank you.
